note: Merge follow-up: 289 -> 288. The unit is mrp.production's inverse hook for `finished_move_line_ids`, which the merge had left spelled `_inverse_lines` while the field declaration named `_inverse_finished_move_line_ids` -- the field pointed at a method that did not exist, so every write through it raised. Renaming the method to the field's own name fixes the defect and satisfies ADR-0049 in the same move, which is why the count falls.
